name: sol8-search-focus
goal: Keep one aligned search focus ring and realistic project scope at every viewport

evidence: Current-code API record b7a7a5b649b8 shows two offset focus outlines and Preview project at desktop, tablet and mobile.
The existing catalog checked query/results but not focus styling. Post-capture assertions now require one wrapper outline and no input outline, border or shadow.
Record 82036765637e at ccbc98db49: all three open states fail because the input outline is 2px rather than 0, with three captures retained.
0ec48f071f explicitly resets the focused input outline width through the search root; the field wrapper retains the visible outline.
2ff7ff2e4c087425ebea2379fb4f8e80be51dc4dfad3ef25dbd246cec12d7ed5 passes all three unchanged viewport cases with retained captures.
